SELECT storeDish.* , sysStore.store_name AS storeName , dishInfo.dish_name AS dishName FROM store_dish storeDish LEFT JOIN sys_store sysStore ON storeDish.store_id = sysStore.id LEFT JOIN dish_info dishInfo ON storeDish.dish_id = dishInfo.id
ORDER BY storeDish.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM store_dish storeDish LEFT JOIN sys_store sysStore ON storeDish.store_id = sysStore.id LEFT JOIN dish_info dishInfo ON storeDish.dish_id = dishInfo.id

SELECT storeDish.* , sysStore.store_name AS storeName , dishInfo.dish_name AS dishName FROM store_dish storeDish LEFT JOIN sys_store sysStore ON storeDish.store_id = sysStore.id LEFT JOIN dish_info dishInfo ON storeDish.dish_id = dishInfo.id
ORDER BY storeDish.create_time DESC

SELECT storeDish.* , sysStore.store_name AS storeName , dishInfo.dish_name AS dishName FROM store_dish storeDish LEFT JOIN sys_store sysStore ON storeDish.store_id = sysStore.id LEFT JOIN dish_info dishInfo ON storeDish.dish_id = dishInfo.id WHERE storeDish.id = #{id}

SELECT storeDish.store_id AS storeId, sysStore.store_name AS storeName, storeDish.dish_id AS dishId, dishInfo.dish_name AS dishName, storeDish.sale_price AS salePrice, storeDish.sale_status AS saleStatus, storeDish.stock_count AS stockCount, dishInfo.dish_img AS dishImg, dishInfo.flavor AS flavor, dishInfo.is_spicy AS isSpicy, dishInfo.is_vegetarian AS isVegetarian, dishInfo.category_id AS categoryId, dishCategory.category_name AS categoryName FROM store_dish storeDish LEFT JOIN sys_store sysStore ON storeDish.store_id = sysStore.id LEFT JOIN dish_info dishInfo ON storeDish.dish_id = dishInfo.id LEFT JOIN dish_category dishCategory ON dishInfo.category_id = dishCategory.id WHERE storeDish.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY dishCategory.sort ASC, dishInfo.create_time DESC
